items.name: DrawGroupDrawEffects
items.plate_exact: INVENTED NAME, not canonical: this helper is absent from the debug-symbol spreadsheet (probably static). Named for what it does: walks the draw group's effect nodes - glares (type 2) to RGlareManager::AddModelGlare, type 6 to a null function, anything else "Unhandled effect type". Called by DrawGroupDrawInstance and DrawInstance. PS2 counterpart 0x001ad1a0. Previously mislabelled DrawGroupDrawInstance (that is 0x0007ddd0). Xbox: takes the group in EAX.

items.name: DrawGroupDrawModel
items.plate_exact: INVENTED NAME, not canonical: this helper is absent from the debug-symbol spreadsheet (probably static). Named for what it does: picks the draw group's level-of-detail model by view distance, runs the per-instance vector callback, and draws the model with the instance matrix (fog off if the group asks). Called by DrawGroupDrawInstance, DrawInstance and QuickDrawInstance. PS2 counterpart 0x001ad2e0. Xbox: takes the group in EDI and the instance in EDX.
